Independent student prototype. Club listings, categories, dues, time commitment, format and audience come from Georgia Tech’s Engage directory as captured on November 14, 2026, and may be out of date. Match scores, goals and major relevance are estimates from those listings. Dues amounts, where shown, come from Georgia Tech Marketplace listings read on the same day. Campus jobs are CareerBuzz postings supplied on that date. Meeting schedules and rooms are sample data. New labs and makerspace listings link to Georgia Tech source pages. No dues listed ≠ confirmed free. Indoor routes are unverified.
